scenario.topic: Decide what to cook for the potluck
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when deciding on a dish for the potluck: ease of preparation, dietary restrictions, cost, or crowd-pleasing potential?

options.name: Veggie Lasagna
options.upside: Caters to vegetarian guests and is a crowd-pleaser.
options.concern: Requires oven space, which might be limited.

options.name: Grilled Chicken Skewers
options.upside: Easy to prepare and can be made in large quantities.
options.tradeoff: May not cater to vegetarian or vegan guests.
options.concern: Requires access to a grill, which might not be available.
options.best_for: Large groups looking for a straightforward option.

options.name: Quinoa Salad Bowl
options.upside: Healthy, filling, and accommodates various dietary needs.
options.tradeoff: Takes longer to prepare and might not be as engaging for some guests.
options.concern: Ingredients could be expensive if buying organic or specialty items.
options.best_for: Health-conscious individuals and those with specific dietary requirements.

options.name: Mac and Cheese Casserole
options.upside: Comfort food that is likely to please a wide range of tastes.
options.tradeoff: High in calories and might not cater well to guests looking for lighter options.
options.concern: Could be messy to serve and eat.
options.best_for: Those prioritizing crowd-pleasing potential over dietary considerations.
